title: Iran, US race to recover missing crew member of crashed American fighter jet
summary: Forces from Iran and the US are racing to recover a missing crew member from the F-15 warplane, shot down by Iran on Friday. US media reported United States special forces had rescued one of its two crew members.
contentText: US and Iranian forces pressed ahead Saturday in a race to find the missing crew member of an American F-15 warplane shot down in Iran as an Iranian TV station called on people to turn the pilot in, promising a reward. The downing raised the stakes for the Trump administration as the war entered its sixth week.
